description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech\-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.
   

  

 Joining the People \& Organization Digital Transformation team, you will work directly with the Head of Digital Transformation and a close\-knit team of four engineers based in Berlin. Your work will span automation engineering, AI application deployment on top of HR systems — with direct impact on how Flix manages its people technology globally. Are you an engineer who knows how to turn AI ideas into real\-world applications—deploying Claude\-based solutions, building integrations, and putting the right security and governance in place? If you’ve built innovative AI products, like those emerging from HR AI Day and beyond, and have the engineering mindset to take them from idea to scalable solution, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

 This is a pure technical role. There is no administrative overhead, no time\-critical firefighting and no expectation of HR domain expertise on day one — we can teach you the domain. This is an exciting, problem\-solving\-focused role at the intersection of AI, automation, and HR solution architecture. While the technical skills can be developed, what we cannot teach is the engineering mindset, depth of integration expertise, and natural instinct for automation that this role demands.
   

  

 This is a hybrid role based in Gurugram OR Bangalore with a minimum office presence of 3 days per week. The role has a Europe and APAC\-facing scope, with regular collaboration across Central European time zones.
   

  

**About The Role**
* Lead the technical workstream supporting internal automation projects —evaluating global HR system options, assessing integration complexity, mapping data dependencies and supporting potential migration execution from Workday or equivalent enterprise HR platforms.
* Design and build automation and integration workflows using n8n,UiPath and Python — including multi\-step orchestration, exception handling, retries, monitoring, alerting and structured documentation.
* Build and maintain enterprise system integrations using REST APIs,OAuth 2\.0, webhooks, SFTP and event\-driven patterns across the HR technology landscape.
* Develop secure AI integrations connecting platforms such as Claude with HRIS and enterprise systems using MCP servers, connectors, plugins and agent frameworks — with appropriate access controls and user\-level permissions.
* Deploy and operate internal applications and AI\-powered tools on Flix's hosting infrastructure (AWS), including RBAC/ABAC access models, secrets management, credential rotation and audit logging.
* Analyse business processes end\-to\-end, identify automation opportunities and design scalable target\-state architectures that can support both the evaluation phase and eventual migration or implementation execution.
* Engage with cross\-functional stakeholders across Europe and APAC —translating complex technical requirements into clear solution designs and project deliverables across 3–6 month project scopes.


**About You**
* 6–7\+ years of hands\-on professional experience in automation engineering, systems integration, solution architecture or AI application development. Exceptional mid\-level candidates with strong technical depth will also be considered.
* Demonstrable experience building and delivering automation workflows and enterprise integrations — this is an engineering role, not a data analytics or reporting role. Experience in Python, n8n and UiPath is essential.
* Strong working knowledge of API design and integration patterns —REST APIs, OAuth 2\.0, webhooks, SFTP and event\-driven architectures.
* Hands\-on experience deploying and operating applications on AWS,including Lambda, API Gateway, Bedrock, Glue, Secrets Manager and CI/CD pipeline management.
* Solid software engineering fundamentals — Git/GitHub, Docker,structured release management and familiarity with security practices including least privilege, RBAC/ABAC and credential handling.
* Experience with Workday or enterprise HRIS platforms (configuration, integration or migration) is a strong advantage and a meaningful differentiator — though not an absolute requirement if your automation and integration fundamentals are strong.
* Comfort working across European and APAC time zones, collaborating with a Berlin\-based team and contributing to strategic cross\-functional initiatives.
* n8n Level 1 or Level 2 certification is strongly preferred.


 We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!
   

  

**What We Offer**
* Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers \+ 12 discount vouchers for friends \& family.
* Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.
* Hybrid work model: We are an office\-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.
* Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.
* Learning \& Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert\-led sessions to grow your skills.
* Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.


 To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations \- Flix Career
   

  

**Why Join Flix?**
 At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture \- giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
   

  

 As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.
   

  

 If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

description:
**About Globeia:** 




 Globeia is establishing its base along the French Riviera, and we are looking for a reliable, detail\-oriented Administrative Associate to be the first face of our service on the ground.
 



 This is a part\-time, hourly role, 10 to 15 hours per week to start, scaling up as our client volume grows. In the early phase, you will be working mobile, meeting clients across Nice and the French Riviera. Once volumes build, we will establish a permanent office space in the region, and you will have the opportunity to grow with us into that.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an experienced and versatile Senior QA Automation Engineer to lead our testing efforts across our entire application suite. In this role, you will be responsible for full\-cycle testing from exploratory manual testing to architecting and building out our automated testing frameworks from scratch. You will also leverage the latest AI\-driven QA tools to accelerate test creation and improve coverage. If you have a deep understanding of modern QA methodologies, love breaking software to make it better, and want to own the quality standards for a growing engineering team, this is the perfect opportunity.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Test Strategy \& Execution:** 
 Perform comprehensive all\-around testing, including functional, integration, regression, performance, and cross\-browser testing for both frontend and backend systems.
* **Automation Architecture:** 
 Design, build, and maintain scalable automated testing frameworks from the ground up for web applications and APIs.
* **AI\-Assisted Testing:** 
 Leverage AI\-powered testing tools and coding assistants to accelerate test script generation, create intelligent test data, and reduce test maintenance overhead.
* **CI/CD Integration:** 
 Integrate automated test suites into continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) pipelines to ensure code quality upon every deployment.
* **API \& Backend Testing:** 
 Thoroughly test RESTful and GraphQL APIs to ensure data integrity, security, and performance.
* **Manual \& Exploratory Testing:** 
 Identify edge cases and complex user flows that require manual validation before translating them into automated scripts where applicable.
* **Defect Management:** 
 Track, document, and triage bugs clearly, working closely with full\-stack developers and product managers to resolve issues quickly.
* **Quality Advocacy:** 
 Establish standard operating procedures (SOPs) for QA, mentor team members, and foster a culture of quality across the organization.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* **Experience:** 
 3\+ years of QA experience, with at least 2\-3 years focused heavily on building test automation frameworks from scratch.
* **Core Languages:** 
 Strong programming skills in JavaScript or TypeScript for writing maintainable test scripts.
* **Automation Tools:** 
 Hands\-on expertise with modern UI automation tools like Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium.
* **AI Testing Experience:** 
 Familiarity with AI\-driven testing platforms (e.g., Mabl, Testim, Percy) or using AI coding assistants (like GitHub Copilot) to optimize testing workflows.
* **API Testing:** 
 Proven experience testing APIs using tools like Postman, REST Assured, or equivalent automated libraries.
* **Performance/Security:** 
 Basic understanding of performance testing (e.g., JMeter, k6\) and standard web security vulnerabilities.
* **DevOps Basics:** 
 Experience with version control (Git) and CI/CD platforms (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Vercel, etc.).
* **Problem Solving:** 
 A meticulous eye for detail and the ability to anticipate how users might break a system in the real world.

* Build and own the QA automation infrastructure from day one.
* Work with cutting\-edge QA technologies, including AI\-driven testing frameworks.
* Work closely with a collaborative, modern engineering team.
* Clear career progression and the opportunity to build out a QA team in the future.
* Competitive salary, benefits, and a flexible work environment.

title: Lead SDET
description:
**Role:** 

 Lead SDET (Quality \& Release)
 




**Location:** 

 Gurgaon, India (On\-site)
 




**Employment Type:** 

 Full\-time
 




**Experience Required:** 

 5 – 7 years
 




  





  





**ABOUT** 





 Visitly is a visitor management platform used across 25\+ countries by enterprises with serious security requirements — Fortune 500 companies spanning technology, cybersecurity, hardware and transportation. When someone walks into one of their lobbies, our software is what stands between the front door and the building.
 




  





**WHY THIS ROLE IS INTERESTING** 





 Our failure modes are real ones. A badge that doesn’t print stalls in a lobby. A broken SSO integration locks out a customer’s entire security team. Tenant isolation has to hold absolutely, every time.
 





 And the surface we have to cover is genuinely hard: a Java/Spring Boot backend, an Angular web app, a React Native mobile app, an iPad kiosk, physical badge printers and badge readers, 50\+ third\-party integrations, and multi\-tenant architecture underneath all of it.
 





 Testing everything isn’t an option. Deciding what matters most, and being right about it, is the job.
 




  





**WHAT YOU’LL OWN** 



* Quality strategy — build the risk model for our product: which flows must never break, what depth of coverage each one deserves, and where automation earns its maintenance cost
* The automation layer — shape our test architecture at the right levels, integrated into CI, fast enough that engineers rely on it rather than route around it
* Release management — own the release gate, go/no\-go, staged rollout, and rollback. You’ll have real authority here and the backing to use it
* The team — lead and grow a small QA team, hands\-on alongside them
* Production feedback — close the loop between what happens in the field and what we test, including the observability that makes debugging fast


- 


**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR** 



* 5–7 years in software quality, with meaningful time at a product company — somewhere you shipped your own software to your own customers and lived with the consequences
* You write code. Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript — the language matters less than the fact that you build tools rather than only use them
* You’ve built or substantially rebuilt an automation framework and put it into CI, and can explain the trade\-offs you made
* You’ve owned or co\-owned a release process, and you’ve been in a production incident
* You have opinions about testing that you can argue for — and that you’ve changed at least once





 ﻿
 





**Bonus:** 

 hardware or device matrices, multi\-tenant SaaS, SSO/SAML/SCIM, mobile or kiosk testing.
 




  





**WHO THIS ISN’T FOR** 





 We’ll be direct, because it saves us both time.
 





 This isn’t a role where you bring the process that worked at your last company and install it here. Our constraints are different — smaller team, faster cycles, stranger test surface, higher stakes per defect. A playbook built for a twenty\-person QA org and a two\-week regression cycle won’t survive contact with how we work.
 





 It’s also not a role for a pure QA management profile. If your experience is running testing as a separate function or a services engagement — headcount, test case volume, defect throughput — this will be a poor fit in both directions.
 




  






 We care much less about test case counts, certifications, or deep expertise in one specific tool. We care much more about how you decide what’s worth testing when you can’t test everything, what you do when there’s no spec and the person who built the feature has moved on, and whether you can change your mind when the evidence changes.
 




  





  





**WHAT WE OFFER** 



* Full ownership of a function, built from the ground up, with a direct line to leadership
* Meaningful equity in a profitable, growing company
* A hard technical problem, with enterprise customers who hold us to a high bar
* No layers between you and the decisions
